Debrief DB-021
1) The actor performed self-help evictions, leaving a documented pattern of retaliatory conduct.
2) The actor issued threatening notices, creating a verifiable paper trail of intimidation.
3) The actor disabled building systems to deter inspections, generating utility shutdown logs.
